CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sri_quality_category(p_sri numeric)
RETURNS text AS $$
SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_sri IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN p_sri < 2.0 THEN 'Excellent'
    WHEN p_sri < 3.0 THEN 'Good'
    WHEN p_sri < 4.0 THEN 'Fair'
    ELSE 'Poor'
END;
$$ LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE;
